summary: Validated French passenger-side rendering of scheduled service categories: out-of-window scheduled services appear GREYED with a time-window badge (no longer hidden), while manually-deactivated services remain HIDDEN. Setup done via admin API: Moto -> schedule_enabled=true, window 14:00-14:30 all days, Europe/Paris (current Paris time ~09:48, so out-of-window). Pets -> active=false, schedule_enabled=false (manual deactivation, control case). All 5 acceptance checks PASSED on /taxi grid view as the rider rider.qa@demo.sb. Final state restored: all 17 service categories set back to active=true / schedule_enabled=false (24/7).
critical_code_review_comments: TaxiModeGrid.jsx line 16: filter is `catConfig[m.id]?.active !== false` — works as expected (hides only manually inactive). Good distinction between active=false (hidden) and available=false (greyed + badge).

Badge strip uses `hint.replace('Dispo ', '')` to drop the 'Dispo ' prefix from the backend label — relies on backend always emitting that exact prefix. If backend i18n changes the label, badge text will silently fall back to full label. Consider returning a structured array of windows from backend in addition to the localized string for robustness.

Banner copy in TaxiHubPage.js line 430 concatenates hint after a space; produces correct French sentence here ('Ce service est actuellement indisponible. Dispo 14h-14h30.'). Acceptable for current scope.

seed_data_creation: Temporarily set moto schedule 14:00-14:30 Europe/Paris and pets active=false; both restored to active=true + schedule_enabled=false at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Service categories model exposes `active`, `available_now`, `availability_hint` in GET /api/service-categories. Frontend rule: active=false -> tile hidden; active=true + schedule_enabled=true + available_now=false -> tile visible with opacity-60 + data-testid mode-hint-<id> badge. Banner data-testid mode-unavailable-banner includes the hint when present. To reproduce, schedule a service to a window not covering current Europe/Paris time via PUT /api/admin/service-categories/<key>.
